text: Every game starts the same way.
So why do you keep losing by move ten?
Meet OpeningCoach. Don't let your opening checkmate you.
It maps every opening you play, and compares it with nearly twenty-two thousand strong games.
It finds the lines where you keep getting forked, and shows exactly how many points they cost you.
Then it builds a study plan that fits your time. One hour fixes more than half.
Got a big game coming up? Scout your rival, and steer into the lines where they struggle.
And learn from the legends. Carlsen. Kasparov. Fischer. Morphy.
